title: Stacked day-view events now show real depth instead of jumbled text
summary: Overlapping events in Day view used to nudge apart slightly, which still left their titles and times overlapping and hard to read. Collapsed cards now fan out with a clear layered look (each card behind the front one is scaled down and offset diagonally, like a stack of cards), and only the front card's text is shown until you click to spread them out.

The class column no longer eats up a fixed chunk of the screen. If there are no events that day, classes now use the full width; if there are events, the event column only takes as much room as the busiest overlapping cluster actually needs, leaving more space for classes.
